connectionId.description: DebugTools connection id. Omit when the project has exactly one active connection. When multiple active connections exist, connectionId is required to avoid invoking the wrong JVM.

parameterTypes.description: Target method parameter type names in declaration order. Provide fully qualified type names when overloads exist.

argsJson.description: Method arguments as the same argument JSON produced by the DebugTools UI. argsJson must be a JSON object whose values are RunContentDTO objects, for example {"name":{"type":"simple","content":"codex"},"age":{"type":"simple","content":18}}. Use parameter names such as name and age when they are available, and keep entries in method declaration order; when reliable parameter names are unavailable, use ordered fallback keys such as arg0 and arg1. Do not wrap this object in targetMethodContent. Supported type values include simple, json_entity, enum, bean, lambda, request, response, file, and class. When parameter names, default values, or RunContentDTO types are unclear, call generate_method_args_template first and use its argsJson result. Omit argsJson or use {} for no-arg methods.

headers.description: Headers for this invocation. They override connection headers, which override global headers.

xxlJobParam.description: Optional XXL-JOB parameter passed to the target method invocation context.

traceMyBatis.description: Whether MyBatis method tracing is enabled.

traceSkipStartGetSetCheckBox.description: Whether getter and setter style methods should be skipped.

traceBusinessPackageRegexp.description: Package prefix or regexp for business methods that should be traced.

traceIgnorePackageRegexp.description: Package prefix or regexp for methods that should be ignored by tracing.

traceMethodDTO.description: Optional TraceMethodDTO configuration passed through to DebugTools.

methodAroundContent.description: Optional Method Around Java source content executed around the target method.

methodAroundName.description: Optional saved Method Around script name without the .java suffix. Use list_method_around_scripts to discover names; methodAroundContent takes precedence when both are provided.

methodAroundContentIdentity.description: Optional identity for Method Around content. If omitted, DebugTools uses the md5 of methodAroundContent.

classLoaderIdentity.description: Optional target classLoader identity. Defaults to the selected classLoader on the connection; omit unless the user selected or requested a specific classLoader.

timeoutMillis.description: Timeout in milliseconds while waiting for the target JVM response.

resultView.description: Optional result representation. Defaults to TO_STRING; JSON and DEBUG fetch the existing offsetPath HTTP views.
